context._note: TOOLS.md (~16k) and .agents/tools.json (~23k) were removed from this pinned array on 2026-06-08 — they are read-on-demand references (GEMINI.md:4 / AGENTS.md:468) and jitContext loads them when needed. This dropped ~39k tokens of fixed per-turn context (~70% of the base). includeDirectoryTree set false; use `uv run list-workspace-files` for bounded scans. Rollback baseline recorded in develop_spec/follow_ups.md.

fileFiltering._note: respectGitIgnore=false lets native file tools (ReadFile/Glob/SearchText/ReadFolder) read git-ignored generated artifacts under workspaces/**/interns/ (git still does NOT commit them - this flag only affects agent file visibility, not git). With git filtering off, .geminiignore is the SOLE visibility denylist and must hide secrets/PHI/heavy files on its own.

tools._policyEngineNote: `tools.allowed` is deprecated. Forward-looking equivalent rules live in .gemini/policies/autoresearch.toml; workspace-tier policies are non-functional today (gemini-cli#18186), so this allowlist still drives behavior. Symlink the .toml file into ~/.gemini/policies/ to silence the deprecation warning until the workspace tier ships.

experimental._enableAgentsNote: Set false on 2026-06-09. Gemini auto-spawned a `generalist` subagent for blocker-panel prep (against AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md Agent Delegation Rule); the subagent could not read git-ignored interns/ via ReadFile (subagents hard-respect .gitignore, unlike the main agent under respectGitIgnore=false) and looped on policy-denied fallbacks until cancelled. The main agent handles onboarding/blocker/results without subagents. Flip back to true only for explicit, user-requested subagent/parallel work. Rollback: set enableAgents=true.
